bias.en: Uptrend under pressure · slipped under the 100-day
bias.zh: 上升趋势承压 · 跌破 100 日均线

read.en: Nvidia fell 1.4% on Oct 16 to $214.13, trading between $213.34 and $218.68. It is below its falling 5-day ($221.5), 10-day ($228.3) and 30-day ($225.3) averages and just under the rising 100-day ($214.5), and above the rising 200-day ($203.0). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and has slipped below zero with a widening histogram, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($240.28), and RSI is 37.5.
read.zh: 英伟达 10月16日下跌 1.4%，收于 $214.13，盘中区间 $213.34–218.68。股价位于下行的 5 日（$221.5）、10 日（$228.3）和 30 日均线（$225.3）下方，略低于上行的 100 日均线（$214.5），仍在上行的 200 日均线（$203.0）之上。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，现已跌破零轴，柱状图扩大，抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$240.28），RSI 为 37.5。

read.en: The close slipped just below the 100-day average ($214.5), the support that held on Oct 15, while the $212.9 Oct 15 low held. Resistance is $214.5 (100-day), then $218.7–219.6 (Oct 16 high, Oct 14 low) and $221.5–225.3 (5 and 30-day averages). Support is $212.9, then $207–209 (Aug 24 and Sep 14 lows) and $203 (200-day). A close below $212.9 would open $207–209.
